messages:
olivia: Quick follow-up from the all-hands—can we pin the canonical RCA + final owner/action list for last week's outage? Need to sync with customers and the support playbook.
alex: Draft RCA: https://go.redwood/rca/2026-03-outage (internal). Adding timeline + root cause now.
alex: TL;DR: transient GPU-router TLS resets -> retries -> KV cache pressure -> latency spike -> retry amplification.
sam: Current owners I have: sam (eng-sre) runbook + postmortem; jun (infra) patch + canary; maria (product) comms + status; katie (reliability) alerts + evals.
jun: Patch PR: https://go.redwood/pr/RW-4512. Fixes reconnect backoff and defensive queuing. Canary planned tomorrow morning.
sam: Created runbook ticket RW-4578, will add mitigation steps and quick checks for oncall.
alex: Repro snippet we used during debug: curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"hi","max_tokens":1}' — observed repeated 502/504 under concurrency.
jun: Spike at 03:12 UTC: errors targeted gpu-router instances a-e. Logs show `connection reset by peer` from upstream_tls.
maria: ETA for status page update? Need a short customer note.
katie: Drafting status blurb, can post within 90m :hourglass_flowing_sand:.
incident-bot: Runbook RW-4578 created by sam.
olivia: Does RCA include the rollback/fallback policy change?
alex: Yes—policy: on latency SLO breach >X% for Y minutes, auto-route to smaller model variant + disable batching for affected route. Details: https://go.redwood/docs/fallbacks
maria: I'll include the policy summary in the customer comms.
sam: Action items summary: RW-4512 (patch) - jun; RW-4578 (runbook) - sam; RW-4600 (monitoring) - katie; RW-4621 (comms) - maria. I'll update RCA owners/due dates.
katie: Also building a small eval set to detect regression patterns (tag: reliability/regressions). Will add example prompts to the RCA.
jun: Canary schedule: tomorrow 08:00 PT (invite sent). If green, deploy to dedicated pool by 12:00 PT.
olivia: Can we do a 30-min sync tomorrow 08:30 PT to align on canary signals and comms?
sam: +1, add runbook quick checks to the agenda.
maria: Customer comms draft: https://go.redwood/doc/comms-draft-4621 — please comment before EOD.
alex: Linking dashboards: https://go.redwood/dash/slo-delta and https://go.redwood/dash/error-heatmap.
olivia: Thanks all. Ping @sam or @jun if anything blocks. I'll post an all-hands follow-up email with the RCA link once Alex confirms timeline. :thumbsup:
